description: This script fetches an OpenAPI specification JSON from a dynamic URL based on environment configuration or defaults, and saves it to a local file within a generated API directory.

methods.name: resolveApiBaseUrl
methods.description: Determines the base URL for the API by checking environment variables, fallback configuration files, or defaulting to localhost.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that constructs the openapi URL, fetches the JSON, and writes it to a local file.
